title: V3B — Model Allocator UI (status + lifecycle) (CLOSED: verdict APPROVED, committed Father 1e879c7 + model-allocator README 65709de, both pushed)
design_notes:
Handoff 72 is COMPLETE. V3B — Model Allocator UI (status + lifecycle) was implemented by imple01pay (Father-only), passed review01pay (PASS) + review02pay verdict (APPROVED, clean), committed + pushed by the Human on 2026-07-09. Plus a comprehensive model-allocator README.

Commits: Father 1e879c7 (4 files, +429) pushed (aac539a..1e879c7); model-allocator 65709de (README, +302/-21) pushed (8b0451e..65709de). Clean staging — Father: routers/bridge.py (+129) + scripts/init_db.py (+88) + static/js/dpmtf-app.js (+212) + databases/dpmtf.db (i18n re-seed). Protected files (command_builder/start_coding/dispatch/bridge_lib/app/config) + V3A endpoints UNCHANGED.

V3B delivered: the second slice of bridgeV002 UI integration (scope §16.4). V3A added configure+validate; V3B adds runtime status + lifecycle control + persistent validation.
- routers/bridge.py: 3 new POST endpoints alongside V3A's — /allocator/status (30s timeout), /allocator/start (200s — model load), /allocator/stop (60s). Shell out to scripts/model-allocator wrapper via config.get_project_path, parse JSON (text fallback), 502 on failure. V3A endpoints (aliases/validate) unchanged.
- dpmtf-app.js: renderAllocatorCardStatus() — status card on allocator-managed role cards (validation status + runtime running/alive/healthy/pid/port + GPU policy + last-validated timestamp) + Start/Stop/Refresh/Validate buttons. Auto-refresh after Start/Stop; disable logic (Stop when not running, Start when running); confirm before Stop. Direct roles: no card. Pure DOM (el/createElement/textContent), no innerHTML, all lbl().
- init_db.py: 12 i18n labels across 4 layers in 4 locales (en-US, da-DK, de-DE, sv-SE). INSERT OR IGNORE idempotent.
- Persistent last-validation: localStorage key ma_validate_<alias> = {result, timestamp} (survives page reload, no DB schema change). CUDA0/1 policy displayed.

LIVE-VALIDATED: POST /allocator/status for imple01-local returns running/reachable/model_available=true + backend ollama. Roles panel shows status card + buttons on allocator-managed roles; direct roles show no card.

README (model-allocator 65709de): comprehensive documentation — 3-layer separation, all adapters (Ollama/llama.cpp TurboQuant/openai_compatible/OpenCode/Claude Code) + client/backend matrix, 11 CLI commands + semantics, config (aliases/profiles/roles/lifecycle), bridgeV002 integration + OpenCode --model bug history, quick-start (incl. local TurboQuant), version history V1A→V3B with commits, live-validation results, known limitations.

7 Architect decisions baked into handoff 72: (1) 3 lifecycle endpoints (30/200/60s timeouts); (2) status card on allocator-managed roles; (3) Start/Stop/Refresh/Validate buttons; (4) localStorage persistence; (5) CUDA0/1 display; (6) i18n 4-layer 4-locale; (7) FastAPI deferred (Father-proxy approach).

bridgeV002 invariant preserved: protected files + V3A endpoints UNCHANGED (verified by review01pay + review02pay + verdict). model-allocator repo NOT touched by V3B (only Father endpoints shell out to CLI). README is a docs-only model-allocator commit.

NOTE on flow timing: review01pay was slow to start after imple01pay's signal-complete (~50 min gap, looked stalled) but then completed quickly (review01 18:05, verdict 18:06). NOT stuck — just slow local-Ollama review01pay. Memory note updated.

Full model-allocator series: V1A (48ed685) → V1B (05a3bf6+Father 7a18b06) → V2 (4dac69e) → V2.1 (6298345) → V2.2 (8b0451e+Father 0b687a6) → V2.3 (Father 74a1179) → V3A (Father aac539a) → V3B (Father 1e879c7) + README (65709de). All committed + pushed. All adapters live-validated. Full UI integration (V3A+V3B). Comprehensive README.
open_gaps: V3B COMPLETE (handoff 72): Father 1e879c7 + model-allocator README 65709de committed + pushed. active_role back to archi01pay. WebUI now shows status cards + Start/Stop/Refresh/Validate on allocator-managed roles.
